subtitle: Lesson 57 · Subqueries, CTEs, and Views

eyebrow: Two parts, joined with UNION ALL
code:
WITH BOMHierarchy AS (
  -- Anchor: the starting point
  SELECT ProductAssemblyID, ComponentID, 0 AS Level
  FROM Production.BillOfMaterials
  WHERE ProductAssemblyID = 800

  UNION ALL

  -- Recursive: references BOMHierarchy itself
  SELECT bom.ProductAssemblyID, bom.ComponentID, bh.Level + 1
  FROM Production.BillOfMaterials AS bom
  INNER JOIN BOMHierarchy AS bh
      ON bom.ProductAssemblyID = bh.ComponentID
)
SELECT * FROM BOMHierarchy ORDER BY Level;
caption: Walks an assembly's components, then components-of-components, however deep that goes.

steps.label: RECURSIVE
steps.sub: runs again and again, +1 level each time
